notablePrerequisites: You control at least four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats - one of which doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat, untapping the basic land.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 two additional times.
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat.
Activate the creature by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
